title: Works well on area rugs, only ok on bare floors. Makes a squealing noise
text:
Works well on area rugs, only ok on bare floors. Makes a squealing noise. I'm a fan of stick vacs for daily quick removal of dog hair. I have a five year old Dirt Devil stick that's going strong, so I had high expectations for this one.

This has the ability to be a hand vac and a long cord and it weighs next to nothing. The bin is easy to remove and empty, but as with my older Dirt Devil, you have to pull out the dusty filter first. I dislike that detail, but it's not the end of the world.

This is actually good for area rugs - the brush spins fast enough to pull dog hair and whatnot out of the rug. Use on bare floors is so-so and I think the Bissell stick is better for bare floors and pet hair. My real issue is that this unit is very loud - louder than my Dyson cordless with it's more powerful motor. Additionally, there's a weird, high pitched squeal on my vacuum. It's enough to make me choose one of the other small vacuums that I already have on hand.
